column1: # The project-layer scaffold registry. `setup.sh --bootstrap` reads THIS FILE to decide what to
# write into a consumer repo. To add a scaffolded file: drop the template under templates/project/
# and add one row here. No shell editing.
#   dest         path in the consumer repo, relative to its root
#   mode         file mode to chmod after writing (e.g. 644, 755)
#   when         always | ui           -- `ui` writes only when bootstrap detects a UI
#   summary      one line, printed by bootstrap and used in its TODO notes
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. Existing files are NEVER overwritten; a
# present destination is reported as skipped, exactly like the manifest and gate shim.
